The '''121st Regiment''' was a [[Regiment/Legends|regiment]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] that utilized [[All Terrain Attack Pod|AT-APs]],<ref name="AT-AP" /> [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TEs]],<ref name="AT-TE" /> and [[HAVw A6 Juggernaut/Legends|HAVw A6 Juggernaut]]<ref name="Tank" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> The unit's vehicles had [[Color/Legends|green]] markings.<ref name="AT-AP" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes that the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] took place in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> six [[Standard day/Legends|days]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], the 121st Regiment took part in a [[Battle of Herdessa (Clone Wars)|battle]] on<ref name="GaW" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|II|34|Herdessa}}</ref> [[Herdessa/Legends|Herdessa]].<ref name="GaW" />
